attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Mexico state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per NM tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "New Mexico Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate New Mexico tax - Single filer (6 progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.nm_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /nm_agi xdef
nm_agi result.nm_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /nm_taxable_income xdef
0 /nm_tax xdef
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_1_limit min result.nm_bracket_1_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_1_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_2_limit min result.nm_single_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_2_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_2_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_3_limit min result.nm_single_bracket_2_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_3_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_3_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_4_limit min result.nm_single_bracket_3_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_4_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_4_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_5_limit min result.nm_single_bracket_4_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_5_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_5_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_single_bracket_5_limit sub result.nm_bracket_6_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"New Mexico tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate New Mexico tax - Married filing jointly (6 progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.nm_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /nm_agi xdef
nm_agi result.nm_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max /nm_taxable_income xdef
0 /nm_tax xdef
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_1_limit min result.nm_bracket_1_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_1_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_2_limit min result.nm_joint_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_2_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_2_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_3_limit min result.nm_joint_bracket_2_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_3_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_3_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_4_limit min result.nm_joint_bracket_3_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_4_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_4_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_5_limit min result.nm_joint_bracket_4_limit sub 0 max result.nm_bracket_5_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_5_limit gt { nm_taxable_income result.nm_joint_bracket_5_limit sub result.nm_bracket_6_rate mul nm_tax add /nm_tax xdef } if
nm_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"New Mexico tax (Joint) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Mexico military retirement exclusion calculation. NM allows up to $30,000 exemption on military retirement pay for 2025-2026. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize NM military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "NM Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.nm_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.nm_military_retirement_exemption get min /nm_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get nm_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.nm_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"NM military retirement exclusion applied: $" nm_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.nm_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.nm_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No NM military retirement pay - exclusion not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
